description: Photos chosen from the candidates of scripts/build_ood_set.py --discover, after looking at every candidate on its contact sheet. Rule: the category's subject fills a large part of the frame, at most one photo per near-duplicate series, no people as the main subject. Every skipped candidate has a reason code. Far categories other than hands and sky reuse the poultry repository's far titles.

reason_codes.dup: near-duplicate of a chosen photo or of another photo in the same series
reason_codes.subject: the category's subject is small, partly hidden or not the main subject
reason_codes.art: drawing, print, painting, render, diagram, scan or composite
reason_codes.animal: an animal is the main subject
reason_codes.enough: a similar photo of this category was already chosen (keeps the categories balanced)
reason_codes.lab: a plain-background lab-style leaf: covered by the PlantVillage photos
